items.question: How do virtual CFO firms get clients beyond referrals?
items.answer: By reaching founders and finance heads when they need help, such as after a funding round, before an audit or when management reporting falls behind. We map those triggers, write partner-approved messages that open on the specific need and book consultations, so new clients no longer depend on who already knows you.

items.question: How can an Indian accounting outsourcing firm win UK clients?
items.answer: Approach UK accounting practices as partners, not individual businesses. In our UK bookkeeping campaign, messages to managing partners and operations heads offered overflow capacity instead of a generic pitch, which led to 15 meetings, 5 delivery-model reviews and 2 paid pilots. The same partner-first approach can be tested with US CPA firms.

items.question: Can a chartered accountancy firm in India use this?
items.answer: Not to solicit clients. ICAI's Code of Ethics restricts chartered accountants in practice from soliciting professional work, so we do not run outreach for Indian CA practices' own services. We work with virtual CFO, bookkeeping, payroll and finance-outsourcing firms that can market directly, and every firm should confirm its own professional body's rules.

items.question: Will outreach under a partner's name sound automated?
items.answer: No. One onboarding call captures how your partners describe their work, and a partner approves every message draft before anything is sent. Outreach stays low volume and insight-first, and no client names or engagement details appear in messages without written permission. In a trust-based business, discretion matters more than reach.

items.question: How long before we see the first consultations?
items.answer: Campaigns usually go live about 18 days after your assets, access and approvals are ready, and first qualified conversations typically follow in weeks 3 to 4. Timing is not guaranteed: it depends on your market, your targeting and how long your buyers take to review a finance provider.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
